conclusions.axial: statement (A): zero Cauchy data propagates psi = 0; the linear Einstein image is locally selected and preserved (unconditional)
conclusions.endpoint_comparison: local Cauchy truncation is a local differential initial-data restriction and DOES select the Einstein image (modulo gauge); the certified endpoint diagnostics (horizon ingoing analyticity, falloff class) do NOT -- the two kinds of conditions are logically independent, resolving the referee's distinction
conclusions.exact_sequence: 0 -> ker(delta Ric) -> ker(delta Bach) -> ker(L) cap im(delta Ric); with zero Cauchy data the right object is {0} (axial) and the conformal orbit {psi_conf(Phi)} (polar); no canonical splitting or surjectivity is asserted
conclusions.polar: obstruction + repair: the exact witness psi_conf(t^4 chi P2) has zero Cauchy data, is nonzero, and solves L psi = 0 -- naive uniqueness FAILS; the smallest additional hypothesis is conformal gauge-fixing (traceless slice): the gauge subtraction Phi_0 with -3 Box Phi_0 = S(psi) reduces any zero-data solution to a tracefree solution of the normally hyperbolic system, hence psi = psi_conf(Phi_0): selection holds exactly modulo the conformal-gauge orbit

declaration.boundary_conditions: none beyond Cauchy data: no horizon or finite-radius timelike boundary condition is used or hidden
declaration.cauchy_data: psi|_Sigma = 0 and nabla_n psi|_Sigma = 0 for the curvature carrier psi_ab = delta Ric_ab[h]
declaration.domain: globally hyperbolic exterior; Cauchy surface Sigma = {t = const, r > 2m} in the static chart
declaration.operator: (L psi)_ab = (1/2) Box psi_ab + C_acbd psi^cd - (1/6) grad_a grad_b S - (1/12) g_ab Box S
declaration.regularity_class: smooth l = 2 harmonic classes (axial and polar); uniqueness argument is the standard energy estimate for normally hyperbolic tensor systems on globally hyperbolic domains (cited, not re-proved)
declaration.theory: pure-Weyl gravity L = alpha C_abcd C^abcd

identities.axial_constraint_transport: nabla^a (L psi)_a phi = (1/2) Box B_phi exactly (zero remainder)
identities.axial_trace: S = 0 identically on the axial class; L = (1/2) Box + C o (-)
identities.conformal_trace_relation: S(psi_conf(Phi)) = -3 Box Phi (verified on the witness; matches BH2B_POLAR_REACH)
identities.polar_constraint_transport: nabla^a (L psi)_ab = (1/2) Box B_b exactly in all components, B_b = nabla^a psi_ab - (1/2) grad_b S
identities.polar_trace: g^{ab} (L psi)_ab = 0 identically (PDE-level tracelessness; the conformal direction is not controlled)

missing_objects: a canonical Einstein-plus-extra splitting (deliberately not asserted)
surjectivity of delta Ric onto ker(L) (lift questions are separate and currently under repair)
nonlinear closure, complex-frequency mode analysis, or scattering statements (vocabulary coordinator-gated)
an a-priori energy estimate re-derivation (the standard normally-hyperbolic uniqueness theorem is cited)

mutation.verified: the inline Frobenius mode has nonvanishing imaginary part at a rational test radius, so the weakened hypothesis (value datum only) is rejected
mutation.witness: time-odd combination u = (psi(t) - psi(-t))/2 of a certified ingoing axial mode (real-coefficient static-chart operator maps solutions to solutions under t -> -t): u|_Sigma = 0, dt u|_Sigma = -omega Im(psi_omega) != 0, u != 0
